arabic_html:
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟
ٱللَّهَ وَقُولُوا۟ قَوْلًۭا سَدِيدًۭا ۞
translation: O you who have believed, fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: say it straight, with nothing bent and nothing dressed up. The promise attached is remarkable — He will set your deeds right and forgive what came before.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: say it straight, with nothing bent and nothing dressed up. The promise attached is remarkable — He will set your deeds right and forgive what came before.
